blocked.name: The Harvey Tree
blocked.why: NEVER SHIP as an entry. Stood outside 93 Albert Street, planted in the 1960s/70s by businessman Les Harvey. Auckland's City Rail Link project confirms on its own tree programme page that the original tree "had to be removed as its roots were severely intertwined with the utilities (gas, water mains, electrical cables) beneath the footpath": only a CUTTING of the Harvey Tree is being replanted near Te Waihorotiu Station on Albert Street as part of the CRL urban planting programme. The Wikidata/Commons entry (Q140069066) that seeded this candidate has photographs of the original tree but nothing dating it as still standing; the CRL page is the more recent, authoritative, dated source and it is unambiguous. Source: https://www.cityraillink.co.nz/trees (fetched 2026-09-01).
